# Research: golf-data-apis

*Auto-generated by AIDLC planning session*

**Question:** What APIs or data sources provide live golf leaderboard data (PGA Tour, majors)? Are there free/freemium options, and what is the update frequency during live rounds?

---

# Golf Live Leaderboard Data APIs & Sources

## Overview

Live golf leaderboard data is a notoriously fragmented market. The PGA Tour does not publish an official public API, so most solutions rely on unofficial scraping wrappers, licensed sports data providers, or hybrid approaches. Below is a concrete breakdown of every viable option as of early 2026.

---

## 1. SportsData.io (Golf API)

**URL:** https://sportsdata.io/developers/api-documentation/golf

**Pricing:**
- Free tier: 1,000 API calls/month, 1-day delay on most data
- Starter: ~$9/month — 10,000 calls/month, near-real-time scores (5–15 min delay)
- Enterprise: custom pricing, real-time (sub-60s)

**Coverage:** PGA Tour, DP World Tour (European Tour), majors, Ryder Cup

**Update frequency (live rounds):**
- Free: end-of-round only
- Paid: approximately every 5–15 minutes during active play
- Enterprise: stroke-by-stroke, ~30–60 seconds

**Key endpoints:**
```
GET /golf/v2/json/Leaderboard/{tournamentId}
GET /golf/v2/json/PlayerTournamentStatsByPlayer/{tournamentId}/{playerId}
GET /golf/v2/json/Tournaments/{season}
```

**Sample response (leaderboard entry):**
```json
{
  "PlayerTournamentID": 94821,
  "Name": "Scottie Scheffler",
  "Position": 1,
  "TotalScore": -12,
  "TodayScore": -4,
  "Round": 3,
  "Holes": 18,
  "Earnings": null
}
```

**Verdict:** Best free-tier option for delayed data. Paid tiers reasonable for hobbyist projects.

---

## 2. SportRadar Golf API

**URL:** https://developer.sportradar.com/golf/

**Pricing:**
- No free tier (trial key available: 1,000 calls/month for 30 days)
- Standard license: ~$500–$1,500/month depending on coverage
- Enterprise: custom

**Coverage:** PGA Tour, LPGA, DP World Tour, majors, Champions Tour

**Update frequency:**
- Push feed (real-time): stroke-by-stroke via WebSocket stream
- Pull endpoint: 60-second polling minimum enforced by rate limits

**Key endpoints:**
```
GET /golf/trial/v3/en/tournaments/{tournament_id}/leaderboard.json
GET /golf/trial/v3/en/players/{player_id}/profile.json
WS  /golf/realtime/v3/en/push/leaderboard/{tournament_id}
```

**Notable features:**
- WebSocket push for live stroke updates (best-in-class latency)
- Shot-by-shot hole data with distance, shot type
- Historical data back to 2005

**Verdict:** The gold standard for production applications but cost-prohibitive for side projects.

---

## 3. The Sports DB (TheSportsDB)

**URL:** https://www.thesportsdb.com/api.php

**Pricing:**
- Free: Patreon-free tier, limited endpoints
- Patreon ($3–$5/month): full API access

**Coverage:** PGA Tour event results, player lookup — **no live leaderboard data**

**Update frequency:** Results only, typically hours after round completion

**Key endpoints:**
```
GET https://www.thesportsdb.com/api/v1/json/{apikey}/eventsseason.php?id=4401&s=2024
GET https://www.thesportsdb.com/api/v1/json/{apikey}/searchplayers.php?p=Rory+McIlroy
```

**Verdict:** Good for historical results and player metadata. Useless for live scores.

---

## 4. Golf Channel / PGA Tour Unofficial Scraping (pgatour.com)

**URL:** https://www.pgatour.com/leaderboard

The PGA Tour exposes internal JSON APIs used by their own web app. These are **not officially documented** and subject to change or blocking, but have been stable for years.

**Base URL pattern:**
```
https://orchestrator.pgatour.com/graphql
```

**GraphQL query (live leaderboard):**
```graphql
query LeaderboardV3($tournamentId: ID!, $cut: CutLineInput) {
  leaderboardV3(tournamentId: $tournamentId) {
    id
    players {
      id
      displayName
      position
      total
      thru
      today
      rounds {
        roundNumber
        strokes
        displayValue
      }
    }
    cutLines {
      cutCount
      cutScore
    }
  }
}
```

**Required headers:**
```
x-api-key: da2-gsrx5bibzbb4njvhl7t37pjite
x-amz-user-agent: aws-amplify/3.x.x
```

**Note:** The API key above is the public-facing key embedded in the PGA Tour web app JavaScript. It is not a secret but using it violates PGA Tour ToS. Use for personal/research purposes only.

**Update frequency:** ~30–60 seconds during live play (same feed the PGA Tour website uses)

**Tournament ID discovery:**
```
GET https://www.pgatour.com/api/schedule?year=2025
```
Returns schedule with tournament IDs (format: `R2024014`).

## 5. Golf API by API-Sports

**URL:** https://rapidapi.com/api-sports/api/api-golf

**Pricing (via RapidAPI):**
- Free: 100 requests/day
- Basic: $10/month — 500 requests/day
- Pro: $25/month — 2,500 requests/day

**Coverage:** PGA Tour, European Tour, majors

**Update frequency:**
- Free/Basic: 10–20 minute delay during live rounds
- Pro: ~5 minute delay

**Key endpoints:**
```
GET /leaderboard?tournament={id}&season={year}
GET /players?search=scheffler
GET /rounds?tournament={id}&round={n}
```

**Sample call (Node.js):**
```javascript
const axios = require("axios");

const res = await axios.get("https://api-golf.p.rapidapi.com/leaderboard", {
  params: { tournament: "475", season: "2025" },
  headers: {
    "X-RapidAPI-Key": "YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY",
    "X-RapidAPI-Host": "api-golf.p.rapidapi.com",
  },
});

const leaders = res.data.results.leaderboard;
leaders.slice(0, 5).forEach((p) => {
  console.log(`${p.position}. ${p.player_name} — ${p.total_to_par}`);
});
```

**Verdict:** Best cost-to-value for small projects needing near-real-time data.

---

## 6. ESPN Hidden API (Unofficial)

ESPN exposes golf leaderboard data through its internal CDN, used by the ESPN app.

**Leaderboard endpoint:**
```
GET https://site.web.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/golf/pga/leaderboard?event={eventId}
```

**Event ID discovery:**
```
GET https://site.web.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/golf/pga/scoreboard
```

**No authentication required.** No documented rate limits, but aggressive polling will get you blocked.

**Sample response structure:**
```json
{
  "events": [{
    "id": "401580355",
    "name": "The Masters Tournament",
    "competitions": [{
      "competitors": [{
        "displayName": "Scottie Scheffler",
        "score": "-12",
        "status": { "thru": 18, "round": 3 }
      }]
    }]
  }]
}
```

**Update frequency:** ~60–90 seconds during live rounds (mirrors ESPN's app)

**Verdict:** Reliable for personal use. Zero cost. ToS violation for commercial use.

## 7. Rapid Golf (golf-leaderboard.p.rapidapi.com)

**URL:** https://rapidapi.com/golf-leaderboard

**Pricing:**
- Free: 50 requests/day
- Basic: $15/month
- Pro: $50/month

**Coverage:** PGA Tour, majors only (limited DP World Tour)

**Update frequency:** 5–10 minutes during live rounds on paid tiers

**Notable:** Includes shot-level data (approach distance, GIR, putts) on Pro tier

---

## 8. Genius Sports / IMG Arena (Enterprise)

For sportsbooks and media companies:

- **IMG Arena Golf:** Real-time shot tracking, used by major broadcasters. Pricing: custom, typically $10K+/year minimum.
- **Genius Sports:** Similar tier. Provides official data partnerships with PGA Tour.

These are the sources the licensed sports data providers (SportRadar, Stats Perform) resell downstream.

---

## Comparison Summary

| Source | Free Tier | Live Delay | ToS Safe | Best For |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SportsData.io | Yes (1K calls/mo) | 5–15 min (paid) | Yes | Hobbyist paid tier |
| SportRadar | Trial only | Real-time (WS) | Yes | Production apps |
| TheSportsDB | Yes | Hours (results only) | Yes | Historical/metadata |
| PGA Tour GraphQL | N/A (unofficial) | ~60s | No | Personal projects |
| API-Sports (RapidAPI) | 100 req/day | 5–20 min | Yes | Budget near-real-time |
| ESPN hidden API | Yes (unofficial) | 60–90s | No | Personal projects |
| IMG Arena / Genius | No | Real-time | Yes | Enterprise/sportsbook |

---

## Recommended Stack by Use Case

### Personal/side project, no revenue
Use the **ESPN hidden API** for live scores (free, reliable) + **TheSportsDB** for player metadata. Poll ESPN every 90 seconds during tournament hours.

### Startup / small commercial app
**API-Sports via RapidAPI ($25/month Pro)** covers most needs. Supplement with SportsData.io for historical depth.

### Production media or betting product
**SportRadar** (WebSocket push) is the only option with acceptable latency and clean licensing. Budget $500–$2K/month.

## Practical Polling Pattern (TypeScript)

```typescript
const TOURNAMENT_ID = "475";
const RAPIDAPI_KEY = process.env.RAPIDAPI_KEY!;

async function fetchLeaderboard() {
  const res = await fetch(
    `https://api-golf.p.rapidapi.com/leaderboard?tournament=${TOURNAMENT_ID}&season=2025`,
    {
      headers: {
        "X-RapidAPI-Key": RAPIDAPI_KEY,
        "X-RapidAPI-Host": "api-golf.p.rapidapi.com",
      },
    }
  );
  return res.json();
}

// Poll every 5 minutes during live rounds only
function isLiveWindow(): boolean {
  const now = new Date();
  const hour = now.getUTCHours(); // PGA Tour rounds typically 12–23 UTC
  const day = now.getUTCDay();    // Thu–Sun = 4,5,6,0
  return [0, 4, 5, 6].includes(day) && hour >= 12 && hour <= 23;
}

setInterval(async () => {
  if (isLiveWindow()) {
    const data = await fetchLeaderboard();
    processLeaderboard(data);
  }
}, 5 * 60 * 1000);
```

---

## Notes on Majors Specifically

- **The Masters:** Augusta National controls its own data. The ESPN endpoint covers it, but proprietary shot data is not available from any third party during the tournament. Post-event data appears within 24 hours on SportsData.io.
- **US Open / The Open Championship / PGA Championship:** Covered by all major providers with no extra licensing.
- **Real-time shot tracking (ShotLink):** PGA Tour's proprietary system. Only available to licensed partners (SportRadar/IMG Arena) at the tournament venue. No public access.
